title: Dojoswap AMM (Injective) — L2 Phase-2 deep dive
closed_reasons: pair code 290 = terraswap-style dojoswap-pair 0.2.0; exact-funds native checks, CW20 sender allow-list, no admin execute path; deployed interface matches published source
pair admin = factory contract; factory MigratePair/update_config/add_native_token_decimals are owner-only (owner = EOA inj12qy3algm6e0zdpv8zxvauzquumuvd39ccdcdjt) => drain is privileged (P), not E-U
no zero-supply/zero-side pool holds value (94 zero-side pools hold 2 wei INJ dust; 94 zero-supply pools have <=2 wei reserves)
large pools are continuously arbed by live bots via aggregators; pool prices sit inside the orderbook spread (NONJA/DOJO/SHROOM/COKE verified)

locker (code 1178) 'anyone can unstake expired locks' is a published-source artifact only; executing the DEPLOYED wasm shows non-owner unstake reverts 'Invalid Owner' and the lock owner unstake succeeds
LP in pools with >=95% burned LP is unredeemable (immutable burn-address contract) - stuck, not extractable
PampIt market KOGA round-trip: 1 INJ -> 9187.5 KOGA -> 0.9788 INJ (~2% loss); merkle airdrops owner-gated withdraw; Dojoswap staking sender-gated
USDT/USDC pool (old pair code 307) is 9% imbalanced => ~$9.26 net residual arb (optimal 217.75 USDT in; simulation-verified) is the only live unprivileged extraction found

live arb bots route Dojoswap pools (INJ/USDT pool 1321 txs, last 2026-10-11 21:34 via Choice Exchange aggregator inj18hllkv88dp3jnpjamgslp5ez6u8az3q4s0lkxf)
fee collector EOA inj18xg2xfhv36v4z7dr3ldqnm43fzukqgsafyyg63 holds $1,837.20 (147.32 INJ + 586.78 USDT + ...)
LP custody split: $243,000.18 live LP (holders can withdraw), $78,276.41 with >=95% LP in immutable burn-address contract inj1wu0cs0zl38pfss54df6t7hq82k3lgmcdex2uwn (unredeemable)
caveats: The headline E-U ($9.26) is a residual stablecoin arbitrage, not a contract exploit; it is bounded by the small pool size and may be taken by any bot at any time
The published dojoswap factory source does not cover the deployed factory's extra execute variants (dust-only impact); factory was not source-verified via reproducible build
Injective LCD denom metadata is unreliable for peggy tokens (reported 6 decimals for WBTC/inj); all decimals used were cross-checked via pool balance symmetry and DefiLlama
The H-O/P/S numbers overlap by construction (same custody viewed through different paths); P counts all pair reserves because the factory owner can migrate every pair
No transactions were signed or sent; the locker behavioral test ran the deployed wasm locally in cosmwasm-vm; the cw-multitest PoC exercises the published source only
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$9.26 live from Dojoswap (one stale 9% USDT/USDC pool imbalance); everything else is closed by clean terraswap-style pair math + owner-gated factory (P: $321K via factory-owner migration), holder-only recovery (H-O: $248K), or unredeemable burned LP (S: $78K); the $491K triage figure is inflated by a WBTC decimals error (corrected to $321,276.59).
